benchmark_wrap_function: benchmark a python function with wrap_function decorator to measure Dr.Jit kernel compilation and execution times
benchmark_single_run: benchmark a python code block with single_run context manager to time Dr.Jit operations and log results
benchmark_clear_cache_folders: clear Dr.Jit and Nvidia driver cache folders to prevent cached kernels from affecting benchmark measurements
benchmark_clean_and_reset_drjit: clean Dr.Jit internal data structures and flush malloc and kernel caches before running benchmarks
benchmark_wrap_function_async: benchmark a python function with wrap_function decorator measuring both synchronous and asynchronous kernel launch performance
